recommendation.reason: Tasks use research artifacts with executable evaluation and reference solutions; the best reported agent passes 58% of runs.
risks: Most of the announced task set is not yet released.
Some tasks require substantial GPU resources and external infrastructure.
Reference code establishes a working baseline, but passing requires improving on it.

verifier.entry_point: scripts/run_task_verifier.sh IMAGE PAYLOAD.tar DATASET MODE OUTDIR
verifier.full_credit: PASS only if the submission beats the reference on every workload and every metric in the task's beat specification; score measures progress beyond that.
verifier.quote: The result is **PASS** only if the submission beats the reference on every workload and every metric in the task's beat specification.

oracle.quote: To replay a task's reference solution and confirm your site reproduces its expected score:

network_or_api: OpenAI-compatible model provider API (for example OpenRouter)
exceptions: progent_privilege_control needs a gateway model named progent-agent-gpt-4o-mini with a nonzero price and $65 per run in total
GPU tasks need Modal; CPU-only sites do not
runtime.quote:
| **AWS** | The evaluation site: an EKS cluster, EFS storage, an in-cluster registry and the management service, created by Terraform in your account. |
| **Modal** | GPU tasks only: Agent GPU runners and GPU verification. CPU-only sites do not need it. |
| **API keys** | Model calls made by the Agent, and the task model of `progent_privilege_control`. Any OpenAI-compatible provider works (for example, OpenRouter, which is the default allowed model domain). |
